scenes.name: Personal Introduction
scenes.spokenDialogue: Hi I am Muskan Kawatra a digital marketing trainer with over five years of experience in the digital marketing industry.
scenes.cameraFraming: Eye-level medium shot (chest upwards), centered composition
scenes.gestures: Warm smile directly into camera, subtle welcoming open-hand gesture

scenes.name: Helping Students and Professionals
scenes.spokenDialogue: I specialize in helping students aspiring marketers and professionals develop practical digital marketing skills and successful careers.
scenes.cameraFraming: Medium close-up, soft studio depth of field
scenes.gestures: Gentle nod, engaging hand gestures indicating guidance and mentorship

scenes.name: Digital Marketing Expertise
scenes.spokenDialogue: My areas of expertise include SEO, AEO, GEO, social media marketing, Google Ads and Meta Ads, content marketing, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, email marketing, AI-powered digital marketing, HubSpot CRM and marketing automation.
scenes.cameraFraming: Medium shot with dynamic keyword callouts on the right side
animatedKeywords: Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager
scenes.gestures: Confident professional demeanor, precise hand pacing matching topic rhythm

scenes.name: Teaching Methodology
scenes.spokenDialogue: My teaching approach combines theoretical knowledge with practical implementation, real-world examples, live projects, and industry-relevant tools.
scenes.cameraFraming: Medium shot with subtle minimalist infographic cards
scenes.gestures: Explanatory hand motion, expressive sincere facial communication

scenes.name: Passion for Digital Marketing
scenes.spokenDialogue: I am passionate about simplifying complex digital marketing concepts and keeping students updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and AI-driven marketing strategies.
scenes.gestures: Enthusiastic speaking tone, positive facial radiance, natural eye contact

scenes.name: Mission and Closing
scenes.spokenDialogue: My mission is to empower learners with the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence they need to become successful industry-ready digital marketing professionals. Thank you.
scenes.cameraFraming: Medium close-up, warm closing smile, gentle nod, 2-second hold, smooth fade to black
scenes.gestures: Inspiring delivery, warm nod on 'Thank you', holding eye contact before fadeout
